program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen, objects = set(), []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            cells, queue = [], [(r,c)]
            seen.add((r,c))
            for y,x in queue:
                cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx = y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); queue.append((yy,xx))
            objects.append((color,cells))
    marker = None
    for color,cells in objects:
        if color != bg and (len({r for r,c in cells}) == 1 or len({c for r,c in cells}) == 1):
            marker = color
            marker_len = len(cells)
            break
    candidates = []
    for color,cells in objects:
        if color in (bg,marker):
            continue
        ys,xs = [r for r,c in cells],[c for r,c in cells]
        y0,y1,x0,x1 = min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        height,width = y1-y0+1,x1-x0+1
        cellset = set(cells)
        closed = all((y,x) in cellset for x in range(x0,x1+1) for y in (y0,y1)) and all((y,x) in cellset for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in (x0,x1))
        if not closed or height < 3 or width < 3:
            continue
        full_middle = any(y not in (y0,y1) and all((y,x) in cellset for x in range(x0,x1+1)) for y in range(y0,y1+1))
        hole_len = width-2 if full_middle else height-2
        if hole_len == marker_len:
            candidates.append((height*width,y0,y1,x0,x1,color))
    _,y0,y1,x0,x1,color = min(candidates)
    return [[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] != bg else marker for c in range(x0,x1+1)] for r in range(y0,y1+1)]
'''
